meta.title: Nikita Kashin — Software Architect · Fullstack · AI
meta.description: Software architect with 10 years building enterprise systems — frontend architecture, backend services, and incremental migrations at scale. Currently expanding into AI engineering.

hero.pitch: I architect systems that survive production — incremental migrations at Russia's largest bank, offline-first PWAs for retail networks, real-time marketplaces. Ten years across frontend, backend, and technical leadership.

experience.title: Experience
experience.subtitle: Five companies, one thread: architecture decisions under real business constraints — migrations, scale, and teams that have to ship.

sber.summary: Owned architecture and incremental migration from legacy PHP to Nuxt 4 for a large-scale banking product — leading 4 engineers while keeping production flows live under compliance and stakeholder pressure.
bullets: Defined incremental migration strategy from legacy PHP monolith to Nuxt 4: new checkout and product flows shipped without blocking ongoing business delivery
Established a shared UI Kit with design tokens and Storybook — unified checkout, calculator, and account surfaces across a growing codebase
Architected SSR data layer on Pinia Colada with REST and gRPC/Protobuf — explicit cache boundaries for multi-step checkout state
Aligned architecture with bank constraints: CSP security layer, Graylog observability, product analytics, and compliance-aware integration patterns
Led technical direction for 4 engineers — code review standards, Vitest + Playwright coverage, and architectural decision records
Delivered production checkout: tariffs, service calculator, promo codes, 2GIS pickup map, Sber ID auth, Spasibo loyalty integration

itech.summary: Owned architecture across enterprise B2B systems — a greenfield offline-first PWA for a retail network and ongoing extension of a legacy supply-chain platform — balancing new capability with production stability.
bullets: Designed offline-first PWA architecture (Service Worker, Workbox, Push API) for field employees operating on unreliable connectivity
Established Vue 3 + Nuxt app shell and component boundaries for a corporate portal deployed across a retail network
Extended legacy Vue 2 / Bitrix24 supply-monitoring platform with new business modules without destabilizing production workloads
Standardized Firebase integration for push notifications and backend services; built interactive SVG coverage map for complex geo scenarios

sci.summary: Contributed to SSR marketplace architecture and a real-time auction system for a classifieds platform — web and mobile clients sharing business logic at scale.
bullets: Shipped SSR pages on Nuxt.js optimized for SEO-heavy listing and search flows on a high-traffic classifieds platform
Architected WebSocket auction layer with real-time bid synchronization and conflict handling across concurrent clients
Delivered Cordova companion app (Android/iOS) reusing patterns from the web codebase
Unified frontend-backend contract via JSON-RPC with explicit error semantics

sfera.summary: Full-stack ownership of a messenger web client and corporate site — Vue SPA on the front, Django CMS and a Go microservice on the back.
bullets: Designed ASAP messenger as Vue 2 SPA with REST + WebSocket — message delivery, contacts, notifications, and delivery status
Built multilingual corporate site on Django with CMS and a vanilla JS + SCSS frontend layer
Introduced Go (Gin) complaints-handling service — separated write-heavy workflow from the Django CMS monolith
Established Vuetify-based design system for consistent responsive UI across messenger surfaces

weblancer.summary: Four years shipping commercial web products end-to-end — the foundation in delivery ownership, client communication, and getting systems into production.
bullets: Delivered landing pages and corporate sites on WordPress and custom CMS under tight timelines and changing requirements
Integrated WebMoney and Payeer payment flows with error handling and reconciliation
Migrated sites off Tilda and Wix to self-hosted stacks — data migration, redirects, SEO preservation
Built responsive frontends with HTML, SASS, and JavaScript before the modern framework era

supplyMonitoring.title: Supply monitoring platform

retailPwa.title: Retail corporate PWA

about.title: About
paragraphs: I enjoy designing software that stays maintainable as products scale.

Ten years across enterprise systems — banking checkout at Sber, offline PWAs for retail, real-time marketplaces, messenger clients. I make architectural decisions: layered boundaries between UI, business logic, and data; incremental migrations over risky rewrites; explicit tradeoffs documented for the team.
The work spans frontend architecture (Vue, Nuxt, SSR, design systems), backend services (Django, Go, REST, gRPC), and cross-functional delivery with product and design under business constraints.
Currently building depth in AI engineering — LLMs, RAG, agents, and automation — while maintaining an open-source Nuxt module for in-browser audio analysis.
